title: Search for text within clipboard contents
summary: This command pipes the clipboard content into a search tool (like `grep`) to find specific text. It helps you quickly locate a word or phrase inside a large block of copied text without pasting it into an editor first.

steps.explain: Sends the clipboard content to `grep` to filter lines containing the search string. Replace `grep search_string` with your desired command and arguments.

placeholders.name: SEARCH_STRING
placeholders.description: The text or pattern you want to find in the clipboard.
